results.name: cursor-zoom-follow
results.title: Zoom Follow Cursor
results.description: Screen-recording auto-zoom: the camera pushes in toward each upcoming click, trails the cursor on a smooth spring, marks every click with a press and a ring, then eases back out to the full screen as the cursor leaves.

results.name: ui-focus-zoom
results.title: UI Focus Zoom
results.description: A full app surface establishes with one settle, then the camera zooms and pans to an anchored region on its cue and holds the zoomed state, with an optional soft focus halo at the anchor. The surface is a slot with a token-styled skeleton default.

results.name: transitions-scale
results.title: Scale Transitions
results.description: Showcase of scale and zoom transitions

results.name: camera-dolly-zoom
results.title: Dolly Zoom (Vertigo Shot)
results.description: Camera tracks toward or away from the subject while the field of view changes the opposite way, so the subject holds its frame size while the background collapses behind it or rushes in. Focal length is solved from dolly distance every frame against d * tan(FOV/2) = const, not keyframed beside it. Requires depth: the subject sits on the z = 0 plane and the content behind it must be layered or genuinely 3D (translateZ at two or more distinct depths) -- a flat element gains nothing from this move.

results.name: parallax-unzoom
results.title: Parallax Unzoom
results.description: Reveal transition — focus card scales down from full frame as siblings parallax in to form a grid (reverse of parallax-zoom)

results.name: north-korea-locked-down
results.title: North Korea Locked Down
results.description: Realistic map zoom into North Korea with a red scribble circle, locked-down pop-up label, and reddish editorial wash.

results.name: yt-camera-move
results.title: Camera Punch-In
results.description: Dynamic zoom, slide, and 3D tilt-pan helpers for any wrapper (video, include, card) with cubic-easing defaults and an edge-defocus pulse overlay
